source_fidelity_policies.statement: Tables, diagram edges, arrows, indentation and private-name underscores cannot be certified from plain-text extraction. Use original PDFs/facsimiles for layout-sensitive decisions and independently execute derived code in Stage 5.

limitations: Paper4 evidence document placement, required screenshot contents, exact runs and submission names come from QP/MS, not this section. Maintenance subsection 12.3.4 begins later on printed 299 and is not the basis of this link.
Knowledge locator only; no code execution, solution validation or syllabus-completion claim is made.

preconditions: The source specifies tests/inputs, number of runs, expected visible outputs or file contents, screenshot/document destination and any filename visibility requirement.
representation: A Stage 5/6 evidence-capture plan linking each prescribed case to setup/reset, visible inputs, required output/file state and a named capture slot; no execution evidence exists yet.
conventions: Stage 4 designs evidence obligations but does not claim a run occurred
official prescribed cases are distinguished from AlgoCore-added coverage
each capture shows enough input/output/file identity to be attributable
multiple runs have explicit reset/state lineage

decision_rule.vi: Lập evidence matrix case→setup→visible input→expected observable→capture slot; gắn nhãn official hoặc AlgoCore trước Stage 5/6.
decision_rule.en: Build an evidence matrix case→setup→visible input→expected observable→capture slot, labelled official or AlgoCore before Stage 5/6.

action.vi: Trích prescribed inputs, số runs, expected output/file, filename visibility và vị trí evidence.doc từ QP/MS locator.
action.en: Extract prescribed inputs, run count, expected output/file, filename visibility and evidence.doc destination from QP/MS locators.

why.vi: Evidence mark thuộc observable được yêu cầu, không phải cài lại algorithm context.
why.en: The evidence mark belongs to the required observable rather than reimplementing the contextual algorithm.

method_steps.invariant: Each official obligation is source-cited and separated from optional AlgoCore tests.

check.vi: Đánh dấu từng row `official_qp_ms` hoặc `AlgoCore_coverage`.
check.en: Label every row `official_qp_ms` or `AlgoCore_coverage`.

method_steps.invariant_vi: Official obligations có citation và tách khỏi AlgoCore tests.

action.vi: Cho mỗi case, ghi pre-state/reset, exact inputs/file seed, calls, expected observable và capture contents.
action.en: For each case, record pre-state/reset, exact inputs/file seed, calls, expected observable and capture contents.

why.vi: Nhiều runs dùng state khác nhau cần reset để ảnh không mơ hồ.
why.en: Multiple runs using changing state need explicit reset so captures are not ambiguous.

method_steps.invariant: Every case has a reproducible setup and a unique expected capture specification without claiming execution.

check.vi: Kiểm input nào phải hiện trên screen và file/filename nào phải nằm trong frame.
check.en: Check which input must be visible and which file/filename must appear in frame.

method_steps.invariant_vi: Mỗi case có reproducible setup và unique expected capture, chưa có execution claim.

action.vi: Định nghĩa planned events RUN_START, INPUT_SHOWN, OUTPUT/FILE_STATE_SHOWN, CAPTURE_SAVED với tên slot duy nhất.
action.en: Define planned RUN_START, INPUT_SHOWN, OUTPUT/FILE_STATE_SHOWN and CAPTURE_SAVED events with a unique slot name.

why.vi: Event model làm rõ evidence nào còn thiếu nhưng không biến plan thành run claim.
why.en: The event model exposes missing evidence without turning the plan into a run claim.

method_steps.invariant: A capture may be considered complete in Stage 5/6 only after all required planned events are evidenced for the same case id.
method_steps.guard: After the future run produces the required observable.

check.vi: Giữ status PENDING và prohibited claims cho đến khi artifact Stage 5/6 được review.
check.en: Keep status PENDING and prohibited claims until a Stage 5/6 artifact is reviewed.

method_steps.invariant_vi: Future capture chỉ complete khi đủ planned events cùng case id.

action.vi: Chuẩn bị checklist readability, uncropped inputs/outputs, filename/file contents, case id và official/AlgoCore label cho reviewer Stage 6.
action.en: Prepare a Stage 6 reviewer checklist for readability, uncropped inputs/outputs, filename/file contents, case id and official/AlgoCore label.

why.vi: Screenshot đẹp nhưng thiếu input hoặc attribution không chứng minh prescribed case.
why.en: A clear screenshot missing input or attribution does not evidence the prescribed case.

method_steps.invariant: The handoff requests evidence verification but contains no assertion that tests ran or outputs passed.
method_steps.guard: After the capture specification is complete.

check.vi: Tìm các từ run/pass/verified ở past tense và loại khỏi Stage 4 artifacts.
check.en: Search for past-tense run/pass/verified claims and remove them from Stage 4 artifacts.

method_steps.invariant_vi: Handoff yêu cầu verification nhưng không khẳng định run/pass.
method_steps.guard_vi: Sau khi capture spec đầy đủ.

pattern_cards.authority_note: Official obligations are limited to cited QP/MS rows. Method, invariant and repair advice is AlgoCore inference/risk. Fidelity policies are not source issues.
